verdict: THE SIGNS DO NOT PREDICT DIRECTION, IN EITHER MODALITY. Over 42 signed edges, majority-vote direction is 47.6% for protein (p 0.678) and 54.8% for mRNA (p 0.322) -- both at chance. This is not a power failure: positive controls drop at z down to -47, the measured technical false-positive rate is 1.1% against real-protein movement of 3.4%, and the measured protein direction REPLICATES across all three conditions for 22/39 = 56% of edges (chance 25%, p 2.87e-05). The measurement is reliable and the network's signs disagree with it. This OVERTURNS the 4-protein result, where mRNA direction looked right 8/10 -- that was 10 edges.
